math: \begin{aligned}\text{Source display:}\quad&\forall u\in V:\ \lim_{T\to\infty}R_T(u)/T\le0.\\\text{Upper condition:}\quad&\forall u\in V\ \forall\varepsilon>0\ \exists N(u,\varepsilon)\ \forall T\ge N:\ R_T(u)/T\le\varepsilon.\\\text{Literal reading:}\quad&\forall u\in V\ \exists a_u\in\mathbb R:\ a_u\le0,\quad R_T(u)/T\to a_u.\\[\forall u\in V\ \exists a_u\in\mathbb R:&\ R_T(u)/T\to a_u]\ \Longrightarrow\ (\text{literal}\iff\text{upper}).\\F(T)&=\begin{cases}T&T\text{ even},\\0&T\text{ odd},\end{cases}\quad\ell_t(x)=(F(t+1)-F(t))x,\quad x_t=0.\\R_T(u)&=-F(T)u\le0\quad(u\in[0,1]),\\R_{2(n+1)}(1)/(2(n+1))&=-1,\quad R_{2n+1}(1)/(2n+1)=0.\end{aligned}
plain: If an ordinary limit a exists and the upper condition holds, le_of_tendsto gives a<=epsilon for every positive epsilon; a>0 contradicts epsilon=a/2. Conversely real tendsto_order puts a sequence converging to a_u<=0 eventually below every positive epsilon. The iff uses its explicit per-comparator convergence hypothesis. Actual finite-prefix induction telescopes the fixed affine losses: sum ell_t(u)=F(T)u, the zero learner loses0 and R_T(u)=-F(T)u<=0 for every feasible u. At comparator1, positive even horizons give normalized regret -1 and positive odd horizons0. Both maps tend to infinity; tendsto_nhds_unique forbids any common real limit. Thus the same actual process has upper NoRegret and lacks LimitNoRegret.

contract.model: Generic arbitrary-carrier bridges consume the same supplied real loss/prediction trace, not a generic causal algorithm or minimizer producer. Existing meanPredict_noRegret is the actual strict-past mean predictor upper producer derived from Theorem1.3; no meanPredict ordinary-limit claim. The strict obstruction instead uses V=[0,1] and the feasible constant-zero learner, fixed independently of losses and comparator, hence structurally causal.
contract.assumptions: For each fixed u in V and every epsilon>0, a threshold N(u,epsilon) may depend on both u and epsilon; R_T(u)/T<=epsilon for all T>=N. Separately, LimitNoRegret requires for every u in V a finite real a_u<=0 and convergence to a_u. Limits may depend on u and may be strictly negative. No uniform comparator control, absolute-value convergence, rate, nonnegative regret or zero-limit claim.
contract.parameters: Signed comparator regret R_T(u)=sum_{t<T}(ell_t(x_t)-ell_t(u)) uses the same horizon in numerator and denominator. Source rounds1..T are Lean0..T-1. Real division is total at T=0, but both subsequences T=2(n+1) and T=2n+1 are positive and cofinal; the obstruction is not a zero-denominator artifact.
contract.regret: One fixed infinite loss stream ell_t(x)=(F(t+1)-F(t))*x, with F(T)=T for even T and0 for odd T. Signed affine coefficients are unbounded over time. Comparator1 is feasible; it is not a squared-loss, uniformly bounded-loss, or meanPredict nonconvergence example. First four Lean-indexed losses at comparator1 are0,+2,-2,+4.
